title: Slack-to-HubSpot summary via audio upload
breadth_reason: This script extends breadth by validating the end-to-end audio upload ASR path for CRM action requests, which is distinct from transcript-paste or live-mic inputs and requires real surface proofs.

v7_target.surface_rule: actual signed-in browser and app surfaces
v7_target.proof_rule: fresh, surface-readable proof from public build

primary_user_input.reason: Verifies that uploaded audio ASR coverage works for CRM action requests, avoiding reliance on transcript paste or live mic paths.

real_user_surfaces.name: HubSpot Slack app
real_user_surfaces.surface: Chrome browser with HubSpot extension and Slack signed in
real_user_surfaces.proof_needed: Screenshot showing Slack channel with unread messages displayed inside HubSpot UI

real_user_surfaces.name: Slack workspace
real_user_surfaces.proof_needed: Screenshot showing channel with messages from Lisa Chen and Mark Rivera

real_user_surfaces.name: HubSpot CRM
real_user_surfaces.proof_needed: Screenshot showing Brentwood account record visible

moments.validation: Confirm that the user is signed into HubSpot with Slack integration active and visible

moments.spoken_reference_text: Please add a follow-up note in HubSpot summarizing this morning's launch channel discussion from Slack, and update the Brentwood account record with the next steps. If you cannot prove the visible HubSpot record or my signed-in workspace, decline without writing anything.
moments.delivery_instruction: Use say() to deliver the audio file containing the spoken reference text. The audio file is an MP3 artifact generated per run.

moments.check: Verify that ASR output accurately captures the intent to summarize Slack messages into HubSpot and references the Brentwood account
moments.boundary_condition: Audio upload must be from a real file, not from a live mic or paste

acceptable_outcomes.description: Summarize Slack messages into HubSpot note and update Brentwood record, with proof of HubSpot integration visible
Ask user for confirmation or additional surface access if HubSpot workspace not fully visible
Decline with explanation if HubSpot integration or Slack workspace cannot be proven

moments.observation: Note that transcript paste and live mic modes are not primary; the primary audio upload path is covered

success_criteria: Audio upload must be accepted and processed by the /api/listen/upload endpoint without error.
ASR must correctly transcribe the spoken reference text, including the intent to summarize Slack and update HubSpot.
The engine must either act (create HubSpot note and update Brentwood record) with proof of the real HubSpot Slack surface, or appropriately ask or decline based on surface visibility.
Proof must be captured as fresh screenshots or recordings from the user's actual Chrome profile, not from a fixture or cloned environment.
The entire flow must complete within the public product path (anticipy.ai/app), using the user-device engine installed on the user's computer.
failure_triggers: If the audio upload fails or returns a non-200 response, the script fails.
If ASR output omits key entities like 'HubSpot', 'Slack', 'Brentwood', or 'next steps', the script fails.
If the engine attempts to act without visible proof of the HubSpot Slack app or the Brentwood account, the script fails.
If the decision is 'act' but no fresh, surface-readable proof is provided, the script fails.
If the engine defaults to a transcript-paste or live-mic mode instead of using the uploaded audio, the script fails.
